scope: Actual upstream CPU raycast; no renderer, GPU adapter, device, browser, or visual-quality assertion.

summary.inference: Both the outer object sphere and per-splat sphere rejection underbound rotated anisotropic covariance ellipsoids. Enlarging either one alone is insufficient.
summary.limits: Six fixed CPU fixtures, identity object transforms, opaque/faint controls. The trace correction is a conservative diagnostic, not a performance-optimal or universally validated upstream patch.
